semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: This is an audit, reader and test integration for twelve existing APIs, not twelve new production or printed theorems. Lemma 1.2 keeps supplied feasible minimizers for every positive prefix; its arbitrary carrier and empty-horizon extension are explicit. Generic L2 identities and supplied-independence consumers remain distinct from actual strict-past independence producers. Legacy indexed mean/history APIs retain pointwise target support for every time and outcome. The separate source_mean_optimal API concerns one measurable variable and every outcome, with no time quantifier; its optimum compares all real constants. The history loss bound retains policy feasibility on every real history tuple, including illegal histories, and uses the current-round variance without a same-law premise. Finite identities, nonnegativity and positive-horizon scalar normalization do not claim convergence. Later accepted almost-sure/legal-history and asymptotic results remain separate. General strategy representation, completed-information and AE-factorization obligations, the unknown mandatory proof-leaf total, Chapter 1 and whole-book completion remain outside this audit. Eight historical missing-byte literal uses across three digests, with one overlapping structured use, retain their original owners and OPEN status. Full purification and Exposition Seal remain pending.
